prompt: A vast dark ocean stretches to every horizon under a heavy overcast sky. At the very center of the frame, thousands of tiny flickering oil lamp flames float on the water's surface — densely clustered in the middle, growing sparser and dying out toward the edges until only cold dark water remains. Each flame is a language. The outer darkness is silence. The cluster of light is shrinking visibly inward. Shot from slightly above at dusk. Mood: irreversible, quiet extinction, grief without drama. Color palette: deep prussian blue water, warm amber and gold flames, heavy grey sky. Painterly editorial illustration style. No text, no labels, no legends, no axes, no numbers, no words anywhere in the image. No chart elements. Single frame only.
dataset_name: UNESCO Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger
insight: Over 3,000 of Earth's 7,000 languages are endangered, with one language dying every two weeks — and with each extinction, an irreplaceable way of understanding the world is lost forever.
